current: configs/platform.dts iommus DID → of_dma_configure_id/of_iommu_configure → riscv_iommu_of_xlate/fwspec → endpoint probe+generic device group → DMA default domain+attach → probe_finalize/iommu_setup_dma_ops

idma_run_session2 → idma_stream_prepare → dma_alloc_attrs(FORCE_CONTIGUOUS) → iommu_dma_alloc → iommu_dma_alloc_pages → CMA or buddy → __iommu_dma_map → iommu_map/core pgsize → riscv_iommu_map_pages → io_pgtable map
idma_stream_prepare → idma_find_iova → idma_iommu_map_range(PAGE_SIZE) → iommu_map/core → sync_map → IOTINVAL+IOFENCE; submit uses manual aliases
ordinary extent/SG path: alloc_pages(order9) ×20 → SG(5 extents/slot) ×4 → dma_map_sg → iommu_dma_map_sg → allocated contiguous IOVA → iommu_map_sg/physical runs → 2MiB leaves if aligned

facts.statement: Linux driver/core/io_pgtable均有2MiB叶路径：driver bitmap含SZ_2M，core按IOVA/PA alignment和映射范围选择最大合法页，io_pgtable可在2MiB层写leaf。CPU页仍4KiB；IOVA大页不要求CPU虚拟映射本身为hugepage。

facts.minimal_legal_evidence_cost: 检查一次实际root/leaf与跨叶payload；不需因helper固定4KiB否决大页。

facts.statement: Linux把当前DT设备默认标为coherent：RISC-V选ARCH_DMA_DEFAULT_COHERENT，of_dma_is_coherent以该默认值起步，DT没有dma-noncoherent；SG sync在coherent设备上会跳过arch同步。idma代码却明确该CVA6无DMA snoop，以local_flush_icache_all/FENCE.I交接CPU写入与回收可见性。dma_alloc_coherent是API名称，不能证明物理cache一致。
facts.conditions: Linux标记与硬件行为必须一致或由现平台FENCE.I workaround显式承担交接；其它buffer/importer不能省略实际需求。
facts.missing_evidence: AI payload真实加载/CPU填充、CPU→DMA和DMA→CPU cache成本、MIG/实际时序未知；旧板的小buffer成功不证明新40/48MiB集成。

decision_boundary: Keep ordinary 2MiB extent/SG and trusted single-DID two-buffer submission as conditional ordinary baselines. No hardware impossibility or general tenant-safety conclusion follows from current helper. Full net benefit requires real lifecycle, authorization and phase costs; no G1 mechanism proposed here. Stage106 source-only-read checks do not validate current Linux helper aliases; all mappings and revoke costs must be included only for the ownership/security contract actually claimed.
